C-INFRA-CI-BASELINE-20260828.Rationale: Worldline needs CI to enforce the same architectural boundaries as its roadmap. The first implementation is deliberately small: fast local suites and PR/master orchestration before nightly and release engineering exist.
C-INFRA-CI-BASELINE-20260828.Decision: Bootstrap canonical GRACE 4 first, commit the living CI/CD policy as engineering governance, then execute CI implementation only after separate plan approval.

Alternatives.Alternative: Put all verification commands directly in GitHub YAML. Rejected because local parity and failure ownership would be lost.
Create nightly and publishing workflows immediately. Rejected because the current product has no distributable application and the policy stages those capabilities later.
Treat event tests as ordinary unit coverage. Rejected because EVENT BUS IS NOT RPC is an architecture gate.

C-INFRA-CI-BASELINE-20260828.ApprovalBoundary: The approved spec fixes intent and scope. Approval of this document does not approve plan.xml; plan approval must name the executable artifact separately.
